text:
Alex (Account Executive): Heads-up — Velos wants a short-lived hosted API key for their exec demo Tues 09:00 PT. Requirements: inference-only, IP-restrict to their office, TTL 6h, ability to rotate on-demand, and an auditable revoke flow. Can someone spin one up and drop the secure link? @Priya pls.
Priya (Solutions Engineer): On it. Do we create under demo org velo-42 or create a guest org key? Also, they said no embeddings and no file uploads — confirm.
Alex (Account Executive): Use velo-42. Confirmed: generation only, no embeddings, no upload scope. IPs: 34.201.11.10/32 and 34.201.11.11/32. TTL 6h.
Omar (Security): FYI security checklist: 1) Enforce IP-binding (no 0.0.0.0 entries) 2) Add tag `poc:velos` and `sensitive:ephemeral` 3) Disable console preview for the secret 4) Prefer vaulting in 1Password.
Priya (Solutions Engineer): Good call. I'll set tag and vault the secret in 1Password shared note (Velos POCs vault). Creating via internal admin API — snippet:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"velo-42","name":"velos-demo-temp","scopes":["inference:generate"],"allowed_ips":["34.201.11.10/32","34.201.11.11/32"],"ttl_hours":6,"tags":["poc:velos","sensitive:ephemeral"]}' | jq .
```
Response returns key_id and client_secret. I will not paste secret here — will vault it.
Casey (SRE): Make sure the key has `no_console` flag (can't view raw secret via Console) and enable `auto_rotate_on_reuse=false` so it doesn't silently rotate during the demo. Also schedule an auto-revoke at T+7h as safety.
Priya (Solutions Engineer): Noted. Adding `no_console=true` and set auto_revoke_seconds=25200 (7h). I'll also create an Ops play: manual revoke command + script.
Alex (Account Executive): Can you paste the 1Password item link here when done and tag me? Also need the exact revoke curl so PS can run it quickly.
Priya (Solutions Engineer): Vault link (read-only): https://1password.company/velos/velos-demo-temp (access: sales@redwood, se@redwood). Revoke command (for PS / SRE):
```bash
# revoke a key by id
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys/kr_04AbC123/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Replace kr_04AbC123 with the real key_id. I'll attach the short script to the vault note.
Omar (Security): Also require they sign an NDA for demo data. Add note in vault item: `requires_demo_nda=true`.
Priya (Solutions Engineer): Done. Key created: key_id=kr_04AbC123. Secret stored in 1Password link above. I disabled console preview, set auto_revoke_seconds=25200, tags applied.
key-bot: key_event: created key_id=kr_04AbC123 created_by=priya_se ttl=6h tags=[poc:velos,sensitive:ephemeral] no_console=true
Casey (SRE): Scheduled auto-revoke job for key_id=kr_04AbC123 at 2370016045 (T+7h) and enabled audit logging for revoke reason.
Alex (Account Executive): Great. Velos ops asked about key rotation mid-demo (if execs switch laptops). What's our guidance?
Priya (Solutions Engineer): Rotation play: 1) If they need rotate mid-demo, Sales requests rotation in thread or Slack DM to SRE. 2) I create replacement key with same scopes/ips and update vault. 3) SRE revokes old key once new key verified. Quick create command same as above, TTL shorter (2h) for rotated key.
Omar (Security): Approve but require justification in thread for rotation. We log reason in audit.
Priya (Solutions Engineer): Ack. I'll include rotation justification template in the vault.
Alex (Account Executive): Last ask: if they escalate and want Dedicated pool fallback (no hosted key), what do we tell them?
Priya (Solutions Engineer): That requires separate provisioning (Dedicated credential) and at least 48h lead time. For the demo we'll keep hosted ephemeral key — dedicated talk can be follow-up.
Casey (SRE): Logged: incident-free creation. If you need immediate revoke, run revoke command and I'll confirm in this thread.
Alex (Account Executive): Thanks all. I'll share the 1Password link with Velos ops and confirm in-thread when demo completes.
key-bot: audit_log: key_id=kr_04AbC123 action=provisioned by=priya_se ip_bind=[34.201.11.10/32,34.201.11.11/32] ttl=6h no_console=true tags=[poc:velos,sensitive:ephemeral]
Alex (Account Executive): closing loop  please confirm revoke when complete.
Priya (Solutions Engineer): Revoked at 2370012888 via API: key_id=kr_04AbC123 revoked_by=priya_se reason=demo_end. key removed from vault.
key-bot: key_revoke event: key_id=kr_04AbC123 revoked_at=2370012888 revoked_by=priya_se
